priceSnapshot.note: The add trigger fired. That is the single fact this session turns on. The morning published an add at a 1H CLOSE above 65,120 and refused to move it down to meet the tape; five hours later the 14:00Z hourly bar settled at 65,128.1, eight and a tenth points through the line. Price ran to 65,189.8 in the 14:00Z window - the session high, and also the high of the whole 08 Aug UTC daily bar - before easing back. Spot is 65,125.0, up 158.0 points on the morning stamp of 64,967.0, +0.24% over five hours and fifty-two minutes. The honest caveat sits in the two bars that followed: the 15:00Z and 16:00Z hourly bars closed at 65,078.3 and 65,082.9, both back UNDER the trigger, so the break has fired but has not yet held on a closing basis. The session low is 64,918.2 in the 12:00Z bar - 23.2 points below the morning's own low, so the range extended in both directions rather than simply drifting up. Volume tells the story of who did it: the 14:00Z hour turned over 96.65 BTC against 37.95 in the 12:00Z hour, a 155% jump concentrated entirely in the push through 65,120, and the tape has thinned again since. This is a Saturday breakout on one hour of real participation.

reduceIf.confirmation: A 1H CLOSE below $64,650 - held UNCHANGED for a SIXTH consecutive session, and the reasoning is structural rather than habitual. The line's job is to mark where the thesis breaks, and the thing it is anchored to has not moved: the daily EMA50 is 64,696.29, unchanged because the last COMPLETED daily bar is still 07 Aug. The 4H EMA20 has risen to 64,705.09 and now sits almost exactly on top of it, so a 1H close under 64,650 would be a close beneath BOTH the daily EMA50 and the 4H EMA20 in one move. With spot at 65,125.0 the line has 475.0 points of clearance, 0.73%, about a third of a daily ATR. The intermediate line to watch first is the 1H EMA50 at 64,838.13, which has risen 77.5 points since the morning; losing that would be the early warning, and losing 64,650 would be the signal.

addIf.confirmation: A 1H CLOSE above $65,190 - RAISED from 65,120 because 65,120 has done its job. The 14:00Z bar settled at 65,128.1 and the desk acted on it; leaving the trigger where it is would mean re-firing on a level price has already cleared. 65,190 is set one tenth of a point above the session high of 65,189.8, which is also the high of the entire 08 Aug UTC daily bar, so the next add requires price to make a NEW high on a settled hourly close rather than merely revisit this one. Above it the tape thins out fast: the next reference is the 07 Aug high at 65,388.0, 198 points further up, and there is nothing structural in between. The rule that produced this - require a SETTLED bar for any trigger - is the endday session's own lesson from 07 Aug and it has now worked twice in a row.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD but for the opposite reason than this morning. The morning was ADD on a structure that was quietly weakening and sized itself down accordingly. This session is ADD because a published trigger actually fired on a settled bar, which is the strongest procedural case the desk has had in six sessions. Four things moved for the bull case and two against. FOR: the 1H MACD histogram flipped positive, from -8.58 to +1.02, resolving the deceleration the morning flagged rather than letting it widen; the 15m histogram flipped the same way, -4.12 to +2.23, and price reclaimed both the 15m EMA20 and EMA50 it had lost; the 15m stack is now in perfect ascending order for the first time today, 65,079.36 over 65,033.18 over 64,968.71 over 64,865.21, with spot above all four; and the realized-liquidation tape is one-directional, 76 of the 78 most recent OKX fills are shorts being bought back, including a 19-fill cluster between 65,128 and 65,163 that burned exactly where the trigger sits. AGAINST: open interest FELL while price rose, $2,035.00M to $2,017.38M, -0.87% against a +0.24% price move, which means this leg was paid for by shorts covering rather than by new longs arriving - short-covering rallies stop when the shorts run out; and the two hourly bars after the fire both closed back under 65,120, so the break is unconfirmed. Net: same direction, higher conviction, still small size. Confidence 6.05 to 6.50, probabilities 38/45/17 to 46/40/14, and the ledger deploys 8 USDT of the 21.96 it holds - respecting the trigger without abandoning the 64,5xx reserve the morning set aside.

liquidityMagnet.note: The pull is up, and unusually this is a claim about flow rather than about resting exposure. Of the 78 most recent OKX perpetual liquidation fills, 76 carry posSide=short and side=buy - shorts being bought back - against exactly two long liquidations totalling 0.0198 BTC. That ratio has held all the way from 02:40Z to 17:35Z through a 966-point range, so it is not a single cascade. The whole realized book is only $379,990 across the window, which is small and should not be over-read, but its DIRECTION is unambiguous and it is corroborated from two other angles. First, open interest fell 0.87% while price rose 0.24%, the signature of covering rather than accumulation. Second, the OKX long/short account ratio has fallen from 1.33 at 09:00Z to 1.16 at its newest 13:00Z row, so the long side is de-crowding into strength rather than piling in - which removes downside fuel even as it caps how much upside fuel is left. The counterweight is honest: short-covering rallies end when the shorts are gone, and $380k of realized fills is not a large short book.

calibration.rollingRecord: 56 rows on file before this one. The morning called range with a bullish tilt at 38/45/17 from 64,967.0, set position to ADD, held the reduce at 64,650 for a fifth session and - critically - held the add at a 1H close above 65,120 rather than moving it after a 66.9-point miss. That decision paid. The 14:00Z hourly bar settled at 65,128.1, the trigger fired, and price ran to 65,189.8. The reduce was never threatened: the lowest trade since the morning stamp is 64,918.2, leaving 268.2 points of clearance. This is the second consecutive session in which refusing to move a published level toward price was the correct call, after the endday session of 07 Aug logged the same lesson from the opposite direction.
calibration.note: Scored honestly, acting_helped is TRUE for the first time in four sessions - but by a margin small enough that it deserves its caveats stated rather than buried. The morning bought 12 USDT of spot at a 64,967.0 mark; spot is 65,125.0, so that tranche is 158.0 points ahead, +0.24%, worth about three cents on a 201-USDT book. Three cents is not a result. What IS a result is the process: a level was published, defended against the temptation to lower it, and then hit by the market on a settled bar. That is the whole point of running a calibrated trigger, and it is the first clean instance of it working since this file was opened. Two things keep the score from being better than it is. Open interest fell 0.87% while price rose, so the desk is being paid by short-covering rather than by demand, and short-covering has a floor on how long it can last. And the two hourly bars after the fire both closed back beneath 65,120, so the market has not yet ratified its own breakout. The lesson carried forward is unchanged and now twice-validated: a trigger is only worth publishing if you are willing to leave it alone when price comes close and misses.
